_doc: docs/credit-verification/claim-doc-ladder.md. Read by scripts/claim_verify/doc_ladder.py; pinned by scripts/tests/test_claim_doc_ladder.py.
_min_confidence: Same bar as doc-verify (credit_verify/docverify/extract.py MIN_CONFIDENCE): a name the extractor was not sure of names nobody.
_accepted_doc_types: Types are doc-verify's DOC_TYPES. The list is what the approved claim proof ask names (split sheet, producer or mixing agreement, invoice, royalty or distributor statement, PRO registration) plus a label or management letter. A credits page is NOT accepted: it is a public page anyone can screenshot, so it shows the profile's name and nothing about who holds the account (11 of the 15 claims the first real run would have approved stood on one). An email, a screenshot of an email, a receipt and 'other' are not accepted either. A type that is not accepted is a refusal that names the accepted types to the claimant (doc_type_not_accepted; the words are in policies/claim-doc-asks.json). A claim whose class is not listed here is held to the types every class accepts. An organization is not shown to be the claimant's by a split sheet that lists people.
_require_release_on_profile: The approved ask is for paperwork that shows the claimant's name on one of the PROFILE's releases. true: a document that names no release of the profile is refused and the claimant is asked for one that does (no_release_named). false: only a document whose named releases are all somebody else's is refused (releases_not_on_profile).
